summary: Fixed where command detection failing with empty results. The issue was that detached:true option was preventing stdout from being captured. Removed detached from both sync and async where command calls. Also identified the statusline.sh issue - it's a Claude Code feature (ccstatusline) that runs bash with --login -i flags, which opens visible Git Bash windows. This is not an Auto-Claude issue - it's from Claude Code configuration at C:\Users\corne\.claude\hooks.json or ccstatusline settings.
current_status: where command now works reliably. Node.js detection should work consistently.
next_steps: User must run: npm run build
Test 'Invoke Claude All' - should work reliably now
For statusline bash windows: Disable ccstatusline in Claude Code or reconfigure to use Python script instead of bash
blockers: Bash windows from ccstatusline - user needs to disable or reconfigure in Claude Code settings
